prs.label: P1 (Text, pp.88–96) — Isolation and disconnection
prs.p: Individuals are fragmented and isolated; modern life produces disconnection and attendant mental and physical health decline
prs.r: Micro-moments of positivity resonance can be intentionally cultivated through practices (loving-kindness meditation) that increase vagal tone and neurophysiological attunement
prs.s: Regular cultivation of shared positive emotional experiences rebuilds vagal tone, enhances resilience, and generates upward spirals of health and connection

prs.label: P2 (Text, p.298) — Love reduced to sentiment
prs.p: Materialist paradigms reduce love to sentiment, psychology, or evolutionary accident — denying love any fundamental ontological significance or role in explaining reality’s structure
prs.r: Fredrickson’s empirical demonstration that love (positivity resonance) correlates with measurable, objective neurophysiological synchrony: vagal tone, oxytocin, neural phase-locking
prs.s: Reframe love as an objective, biologically-grounded coupling mechanism among conscious agents; empirical substrate for theological and metaphysical claims about love’s centrality to Being

prs.label: P3 (Text, pp.89–92) — Scale-bridging in agent coupling
prs.p: Models of agency (Hoffman, Friston, Levin) describe agent-level dynamics but lack a rigorous mechanism for how agents couple, synchronize, and form higher-order collective agents
prs.r: Positivity resonance as a biophysiological coupling event that scales from dyadic interaction to group resonance (collective presence, shared meditation, communal worship)
prs.s: Micro-moment positivity resonance as the fundamental coupling mechanism bridging individual agents to collective agency across scales: cells to organisms to communities to traditions

prs.label: P4 (Implicit) — Relational coherence of conscious realism
prs.p: Conscious Realism as a paradigm lacks a mechanism explaining how distributed conscious agents achieve stable coordination without external enforcement
prs.r: Fredrickson’s model of biophysiological synchrony as a natural attractor for agent-alignment; love as self-organizing coherence at the biological level
prs.s: Extend micro-moment synchrony to explain higher-order coherence: love becomes the universal attractor mechanism binding conscious agents at all levels of organization

prs.label: P5 (Implicit) — Embodiment of abstract ontology
prs.p: Conscious realism risks being too abstract — how do models of conscious agents connect to lived, felt experience? How do claims about agape manifest in bodies?
prs.r: Fredrickson’s grounding of love in measurable vagal tone, oxytocin, and neural synchrony; her insistence that love is biological provides material anchor for relational ontology
prs.s: Theological and metaphysical commitments to love (agape, Christic morphogenesis) have measurable bodily signatures — bridging abstract theory and embodied practice

prs.label: P6 (Implicit) — Democratizing participation in reality
prs.p: A worldview built on “conscious agents” risks recreating cognitive hierarchies or exclusions based on informational complexity
prs.r: Fredrickson’s assertion that capacity for love is biologically modifiable, learnable, and available to all; love is non-zero-sum and scales from dyad to community
prs.s: Ground conscious realist ethics in universal capacity for resonance: all beings capable of shared positive emotion participate in reality-constituting processes — love as the basis for radical inclusivity

prs.label: P7 (PROP-2026-04-08-008) — Multi-level conducive conditions
prs.p: Positivity resonance theory has been developed at the dyadic level but translation to interventions for community-scale loneliness requires understanding conditions at individual, collective, and structural levels — which are currently untheorized within the broaden-and-build framework
prs.r: Fredrickson’s multi-level conducive conditions framework: individual (listening quality, anticipated discrimination), collective (civic engagement, relational mobility), structural (economic inequality, built environment) — each level modulating positivity resonance availability
prs.s: A hierarchical intervention framework: address structural barriers to resonance first (built environment, inequality), then collective-level enablers (civic engagement programs), then individual skills (listening quality training) — enabling equitable positivity resonance at population scale

prs.label: P8 (PROP-2026-04-08-008) — High-quality listening as resonance enabler
prs.p: High-quality listening has been identified as conducive to positivity resonance but its mechanism — why it works and how to train it — has not been specified within the positivity resonance framework
prs.r: Fredrickson lab finding: high-quality listening boosts real-time sensory connection and perceived safety — these are identified as the proximate mechanisms by which listening behavior enables positivity resonance to emerge between strangers
prs.s: Listening quality training as a targeted, learnable intervention for increasing positivity resonance between strangers — with sensory attunement and psychological safety as the measurable intermediate outcomes

prs.label: P9 (PROP-2026-04-08-007) — Weak-tie intellectual humility
prs.p: Inter-tradition dialogue requires intellectual humility — willingness to learn from those with fundamentally different views — but it is unclear how such humility is developed or cultivated at scale
prs.r: Fredrickson & West (2025) RCT demonstrating that three weeks of intentional connection with strangers (weak ties) produces measurable increases in intellectual humility, prosocial beliefs, and civic efficacy — while connection with close others does not
prs.s: Weak-tie positivity resonance (connection with strangers and acquaintances) may be the empirical mechanism by which intellectual humility is cultivated at the societal scale needed for C2A2 inter-tradition dialogue — a directly actionable intervention

prs.label: P10 (PROP-2026-04-08-007) — Weak-tie community as loneliness solution
prs.p: Models of positivity resonance have focused primarily on dyadic intimacy and close relationships — but the loneliness epidemic is not primarily a deficit of close relationships, it is a collapse of weak-tie community
prs.r: Fredrickson & West (2025) finding that quality of weak-tie interactions (strangers, acquaintances) predicts loneliness, belonging, and mental health as strongly as close relationship quality — extending positivity resonance theory to include weak-tie connection as a fundamental variable
prs.s: Expand the positivity resonance model to treat weak-tie connection as a distinct and essential tier of social health, not merely a precursor to intimacy — and design C2A2 community structures to deliberately cultivate cross-tradition weak-tie encounters

prs.label: P11 (PROP-2026-04-13-009) — Inflammation and resonance selectivity
prs.p: Fredrickson’s model establishes that positivity resonance has biological correlates (vagal tone, oxytocin, neural synchrony) but does not specify how the body’s physiological state modulates the *availability* or *target selectivity* of resonance — who can we connect with, and when?
prs.r: West, Jolink, Feldman et al. (2025): inflammation (IL-6 levels post-vaccination) is associated with differential anticipated and experienced positivity resonance with close vs. non-close others — suggesting immune state as a gating mechanism for resonance target selectivity
prs.s: The body’s inflammatory state is a biological boundary condition on positivity resonance: inflammation may narrow the social radius of resonance toward familiar, safe others and away from strangers. This implies that population-level chronic inflammation (from stress, inequality, poor health) could systematically cons…

prs.label: P12 (PROP-2026-04-13-008) — Community trust and structural inequality
prs.p: Fredrickson’s multi-level conducive conditions framework identifies structural factors (economic inequality, built environment) as modulators of positivity resonance, but the causal pathway from structural conditions to micro-level emotional experience with strangers has not been experimentally established
prs.r: West, Berman, Payne, Muscatell & Fredrickson (2025): experimental manipulation of perceived economic inequality reduces expected quality of stranger connection, mediated by community trust — establishing a causal structural → trust → resonance pathway across three studies (N = 1,867)
prs.s: Community trust is the identified mediating mechanism by which structural inequality degrades positivity resonance with strangers. Interventions targeting community trust (not just individual skills) are necessary for restoring stranger-connection in unequal contexts — a structural, not merely interpersonal, intervent…

prs.label: P13 (PROP-2026-04-13-008) — Why inequality harms weak-tie connection
prs.p: Why does economic inequality specifically damage weak-tie (stranger) connection while leaving close-relationship quality intact? This asymmetry is theoretically puzzling and practically important for understanding the loneliness epidemic
prs.r: The finding that community trust predicts positive emotional quality of interactions with strangers but NOT close others — suggesting that trust operates as a threshold condition specifically for encounters with unknown others, where prior relational history cannot substitute for community-level trust
prs.s: Close relationships are buffered by relational history and reciprocal knowledge; stranger interactions depend on a generalized trust scaffold that inequality erodes. This explains why the loneliness epidemic can coexist with intact close relationships — it is a collapse of the trust infrastructure for weak-tie connect…

prs.label: P14 (PROP-2026-04-16-004) — Conducive Conditions for Positivity Resonance at Multiple Levels of Analysis
prs.p: Positivity resonance research has focused on individual/dyadic interactions — but what structural and collective conditions enable or inhibit these micro-moments of connection at scale?
prs.r: A multi-level framework identifying conducive conditions at individual, collective, and structural levels of analysis
prs.s: Positivity resonance is not just a psychological event but a multi-scale phenomenon shaped by civic engagement, economic inequality, relational mobility, and the built environment — enabling intentional design of resonance-conducive communities

prs.label: P15 (PROP-2026-04-16-005) — Why Loving Moments With Strangers Carry Lasting Benefits
prs.p: Does positive connection with out-group members (strangers, people from different traditions) produce lasting prosocial effects, or are the benefits limited to in-group interaction?
prs.r: West & Fredrickson's finding that positivity resonance with strangers generates prosocial tendencies and contributes to social cohesion
prs.s: Micro-moments of positivity resonance with strangers carry lasting benefits for cooperation and social cohesion — the mechanism scales beyond in-group interaction to inter-group and inter-tradition contexts

prs.label: P16 (PROP-2026-04-27-002) — Improving social connection with weak ties and strangers: effects of a new micro
prs.p: Even when the importance of weak-tie connection is empirically established, no controlled, scalable intervention has been demonstrated to *raise the quality* of stranger and acquaintance interactions in real life
prs.r: A brief two-component micro-intervention combining a psychoeducational video on connection with a planning conversation with a virtual human, in which participants form if-then implementation intentions for stranger interactions
prs.s: Demonstrated experimental evidence (RCT, N = 335) that a brief, deliverable-at-scale intervention raises subsequent weak-tie interaction quality and reduces loneliness — providing a reproducible recipe for cultivating population-scale positivity resonance

prs.p: Self-reported listening quality has long been theorized to enable positivity resonance, but until now the field lacked behavioral, observable, pre-registered evidence that specific listening behaviors mediate the link between a social-connectedness intervention and felt connection between strangers.
prs.r: Two pre-registered studies (N = 646) coding observable verbal listening behaviors (verbal validation, follow-up questions) and global listening behaviors during deep-talk and small-talk conversations between strangers, paired with behavioral markers (response latency) and self-, partner-, and observer-reports of conne…
prs.s: Verbal listening behaviors — especially follow-up questions — are behaviorally observable mediators of a brief social-connectedness intervention's effect on stranger connection in deep-talk contexts. Listening behavior thus becomes an empirically grounded, trainable, observable target for scaling positivity-resonance…

prs.p: Whether the behavioral pathway through listening generalizes from extended (deep-talk) encounters to the brief, casual encounters (small-talk) that dominate weak-tie life is unclear — and weak-tie connection has been theoretically identified as the locus of the loneliness epidemic (existing PRS-09, PRS-10).
prs.r: Study 2 replication-and-extension to small-talk format with the same intervention and listening coding scheme.
prs.s: Global listening behaviors continue to predict behavioral and partner-reported connection in small talk, but verbal indicators are less consistent and the intervention does not raise listening behaviors. This is a substantive boundary condition: small-talk listening may rely on a holistic-attention channel that resist…

prs.p: The Fredrickson program has accumulated many findings (broaden-and-build, upward spirals, positivity resonance, vagal tone, conducive conditions) without an author-sanctioned account of how they connect into a single developmental arc.
prs.r: Fredrickson's own five-breakthrough periodization, each anchored by three curated key articles (fifteen contributions total).
prs.s: A canonical scaffold the wiki can adopt to sequence and relate existing PRS triplets, replacing our internally-imposed clustering with the thinker's own.

prs.p: Translating affective-science findings into evidence-based guidance for non-specialists is methodologically fraught and rarely reflected on candidly by senior scientists.
prs.r: Fredrickson's first-person reflections on scientific method, career development, public-facing translation, and serendipity in discovery.
prs.s: A meta-level account of how a flourishing-science program is built and communicated — directly relevant to C2A2's own ambition to translate tradition-internal findings outward.

prs.p: Fredrickson's theoretical claim that love-the-emotion just is positivity resonance — that constructs commonly grouped under "love" (desire, intimacy, trust, commitment) are all downstream products of accumulated positivity resonance — has been programmatically asserted but not directly empirically tested with behavior…
prs.r: Lai, Otero, Chen, Wells, Levenson, & Fredrickson (2025): a multi-modal observational study of long-term married couples scoring behavioral positivity-resonance markers (synchronized affect, vocal mirroring, shared laughter) and correlating those markers with both trait and state love measures
prs.s: Direct empirical confirmation that observable positivity-resonance markers track self-reported love at both trait and state levels — establishing positivity resonance as a measurable behavioral signature of love rather than merely a theoretically posited substrate

prs.p: For the C2A2 project, claims about "love" as an ontologically significant phenomenon (theological, philosophical, McGilchrist's right-hemisphere relational knowing) need an empirical handle — otherwise they remain rhetorically powerful but empirically untraceable
prs.r: The Lai et al. behavioral coding scheme — synchronized smiles, mirrored vocal tones, shared laughter — provides a concrete empirical operationalization that any tradition can adopt as a measurement of love-the-event
prs.s: Adopt Lai et al.'s behavioral markers as the C2A2 empirical bridge between (a) Fredrickson's measurement framework, (b) Stump's Thomistic union-as-final-cause, (c) Kastrup's idealist account of love as ontological coupling, (d) McGilchrist's RH relational knowing — providing a single measurable phenomenon that multipl…

prs.p: Positivity resonance has been operationalized via multiple incommensurable methods (self-report, observer-coded behavior, physiological synchrony), leaving open whether they actually index the same construct or three loosely related phenomena — a foundational concern for any claim that positivity resonance is the righ…
prs.r: A three-method convergent-validity design comparing self-report, behavioral, and physiological assessments of the same social interactions across the same participants, published in Journal of Personal and Social Relationships (2025).
prs.s: Empirical demonstration of (or evidence about the limits of) convergent validity across the three assessment families — establishing the measurement infrastructure that lets Fredrickson's program scale across labs and contexts, and lets C2A2 deploy its preferred channel without losing comparability.

prs.p: For C2A2 to use positivity resonance as a metric of inter-tradition dialogue health, the chosen measurement instrument must be deployable in real community settings (not just paired-couple lab studies) and must agree with gold-standard physiological measures.
prs.r: Convergent validity findings that bridge cheap, scalable measures (self-report) and expensive, mechanism-revealing measures (physiological synchrony) — clarifying which compromises in measurement are acceptable in field deployment.
prs.s: An evidence-based decision framework for selecting positivity-resonance assessments in C2A2 community studies — enabling deployment without sacrificing construct validity.

prs.p: Positivity resonance theory has been developed primarily for dyadic adult interactions and weak-tie community-scale interactions, but the developmental pathway by which children acquire the capacity for positivity resonance — and the role of the parent-pair dyad as a developmental positivity field — has been theoretic…
prs.r: Don, Simpson, Fredrickson, & Algoe's Interparental Positivity Spillover Theory (IPST): a three-mechanism account of how interparental positive interactions transmit to children via (a) the child's own positive emotional experience, (b) altered perceptions of the parents, (c) emulated interpersonal behaviors
prs.s: A developmental extension of positivity resonance theory: the parent-pair functions as a positivity field that scaffolds the child's nervous system, perception, and behavior — providing the biographical mechanism by which capacity for positivity resonance is constructed in the first place

prs.p: For the C2A2 project, the question of how a tradition's affective signature (its lived emotional grammar — what gratitude, joy, lament, and reconciliation look like inside that tradition) is reproduced across generations has been treated implicitly but not theoretically modeled
prs.r: IPST's spillover mechanism, when generalized beyond the parent-child dyad, suggests that any high-positivity-resonance dyad inside a tradition functions as a "spillover field" for tradition-naive observers — including children, students, AI agents, and second-tradition learners
prs.s: Treat tradition-internal high-resonance dyads (mentor-student, master-apprentice, rabbi-disciple, lab head-postdoc) as spillover fields whose emotional grammar transmits to observers via the same three mechanisms IPST identifies — providing C2A2 with a developmental theory of tradition acquisition

prs.p: A research program tracked across decades fragments into individual papers; without an author's synthesis, downstream traditions risk inheriting a collage of citations rather than the program's actual arc and load-bearing claims.
prs.r: Fredrickson's five-section curation of fifteen flagship papers, each prefaced with the personal-and-scientific story of how the breakthrough emerged — making explicit the implicit research-program logic that ties the corpus together.
prs.s: A primary-source canonical map of the broaden-and-build / positivity-resonance program, organized by the author's own sense of which findings are foundational and how they connect — enabling the C2A2 wiki to ground its Fredrickson tradition wiki in the author's own architecture.

prs.p: Positivity resonance has often been cited in C2A2 as the empirical anchor of love-as-biological-coupling, but its emergence from earlier broaden-and-build work has not been narrated as a coherent paradigm shift within Fredrickson's own program.
prs.r: The "Feeling as One: Origins of the Positivity Resonance Theory" section, which traces how positivity resonance emerged from broaden-and-build research as a distinct theoretical advance — the move from intra-individual emotion to inter-individual co-emotion.
prs.s: A reading of positivity resonance as a within-program paradigm extension (not a departure) — the same broaden-and-build logic operating at the dyadic rather than individual level. This justifies treating positivity resonance as MacIntyre-criterion progress within the Fredrickson tradition: a new theoretical resource t…

prs.p: Population-scale interventions to cultivate stranger-connection require a delivery channel that reaches young adults where they actually are — and social media, while often implicated as a driver of isolation, is also where young adults spend the largest share of their discretionary attention
prs.r: Lazard et al. (2025) experimental optimization of video social-media intervention messages — systematically varying visual framing (connected peers / lonely peers / safe spaces / control) and message framing in a between-persons online experiment with young adults
prs.s: A demonstrated experimental design and message-optimization methodology for using social media itself as a delivery vehicle for in-person connection cues — turning the medium implicated in loneliness into the means of its mitigation. The Lazard attention-capture framework becomes a transferable design tool for any C2A…

prs.p: Fredrickson's positivity-resonance framework has been criticized for offering elegant theory but few mechanisms for population deployment; conversely, public-health messaging campaigns rarely use the most rigorous available emotional-mechanism research
prs.r: A direct collaboration between Lazard's health-communication design lab and Fredrickson's positivity-resonance lab, embedding theory-informed message content within attention-optimized delivery designs
prs.s: A reproducible cross-disciplinary template — positivity-resonance theory × health-communication design — for translating positive-emotion mechanisms into scalable behavioral interventions, with measurable engagement and behavioral-intent outcomes

prs.p: PRS-08 identified high-quality listening as a probable mechanism for positivity resonance with strangers, but the causal direction and the specific behavioral substrates of "high-quality listening" had not been established in a controlled behavioral-coding paradigm
prs.r: West et al. (2025) controlled study in Communications Psychology in which observed listening behaviors (follow-up questions, attentive nonverbal cues) were behaviorally coded and tested as predictors and mediators of both observer-rated and self-reported markers of social connection between strangers
prs.s: A confirmed behavioral pathway — high-quality listening behaviors → perceived safety + real-time sensory connection → positivity resonance — providing the specific behavioral observables that listening-quality interventions need to target for measurable population effects on stranger-connection

prs.p: Positivity resonance theory has been criticized for being descriptively rich but operationally underspecified — what exactly are the observable behaviors that produce it, beyond the post-hoc reports of participants?
prs.r: A behavioral coding scheme for "high-quality listening" — follow-up questions and attentive nonverbal cues — operationalized at a granularity that supports both observer rating and intervention training
prs.s: Positivity resonance has at least one well-specified behavioral antecedent that can be coded, trained, and measured — addressing the operationalization gap and providing the first concrete behavioral target for the kinds of population-scale interventions the C2A2 framework requires

prs.p: Loneliness is robustly associated with worse physical and mental health outcomes in aging, but the mechanism is underspecified — it is unclear whether loneliness degrades general physiological regulation or something specific to social processing.
prs.r: Graph-theoretic static and dynamic functional connectivity of the allostatic-interoceptive system (AIS), measured across matched neutral / pleasant / unpleasant social visualization conditions in the same participants (N = 73, Ma, West, Wulfekuhle, Escalante, Cascone, Frye, Leshin, Fredrickson, Cohen & Lindquist 2026,…
prs.s: The loneliness x age interaction appears in the pleasant and unpleasant conditions and is absent in the neutral one, localizing the effect to affectively salient social cues rather than to general regulatory capacity — a brain-level specificity result consistent with positivity resonance being the operative unit rathe…

prs.p: Broaden-and-build predicts that positive social experience builds durable resources, but the theory has had no account of why the *capacity to be built* should itself decline — i.e. why some people appear less able to convert connection into resource.
prs.r: The allostatic-interoceptive system as a measurable candidate mediator between socially salient experience and physiological regulation, with time-varying (dynamic) connectivity as the sensitive index.
prs.s: A candidate mechanism for loneliness becoming self-sustaining — if the AIS is the machinery that converts a socially salient moment into a regulated bodily response, then loneliness-linked degradation of that machinery means the lonelier one is, the less a pleasant social moment can do.

prs.p: Affective neuroscience has looked for emotion in localized regions; that approach has not produced stable region-to-emotion mappings, leaving the neural status of discrete affective states unsettled.
prs.r: Graph-theoretic static and dynamic network metrics — participation coefficient for cross-network integration, within-module degree for within-network coherence — applied to five intrinsic networks (salience, default mode, ventral attention, dorsal attention, frontoparietal) during a within-subject affect-induction tas…
prs.s: Affective conditions are distinguished by *configuration* rather than by dedicated affect centers — supporting a constructionist account in which emotions emerge from flexible network states. For this tradition it changes what a positive-emotion claim means neurally: the unit of explanation becomes network reconfigura…

prs.p: PRS-33 recorded the loneliness x age AIS result as "consistent with positivity resonance being the operative unit." But positivity resonance is defined by positive valence, and a result that is specific to *socially affective* cues does not discriminate a positive-valence construct from a valence-general one. The trad…
prs.r: The three-condition design read separately by metric rather than collapsed. Static AIS coherence x age x loneliness appears in the pleasant condition. Time-varying (dynamic) AIS integration and coherence x age x loneliness appear in BOTH the pleasant and the unpleasant conditions. Neither appears in neutral (N = 73, S…
prs.s: A corrected reading that confines the positive-specific claim to where it actually holds. Only the static coherence result is positive-specific; the dynamic result — the paper's more sensitive index — is valence-general across socially affective cues. The finding therefore supports "social affective salience is the op…

prs.p: A construct defined by positive valence predicts, at minimum, that positive states are as neurally distinguishable as negative ones under matched induction. That prediction had never been checked inside this tradition's own imaging cohort.
prs.r: The two companion papers read together against each other — same N = 73 cohort, same visualization paradigm, same matched neutral control, different network targets (nsag008 intrinsic networks; nsaf124 allostatic-interoceptive system).
prs.s: In this cohort the negative/unpleasant condition is at least as neurally distinguishable as the positive one, and on the reported record more so. nsag008's two discriminations both involve the negative condition (static DAN within-module degree: negative vs neutral; dynamic VAN participation coefficient: negative vs p…

prs.p: The standing boundary test — does co-experienced grief show the markers of positivity resonance minus the valence? — has been posed but not costed. Answering it needs an apparatus that (a) contrasts valences against a matched neutral control, (b) indexes the allostatic-interoceptive and attention systems with metrics…
prs.r: The nsaf124/nsag008 paradigm supplies (a) and (b): matched neutral/pleasant/unpleasant social visualization, static and dynamic graph-theoretic connectivity (participation coefficient for cross-network integration, within-module degree for within-network coherence) over the AIS and five intrinsic networks, validated a…
prs.s: The boundary test's instrumentation gap is now specified rather than open-ended. Two of its three requirements are already published inside this tradition. The missing one is dyadic co-measurement: both papers scan a single participant visualizing an absent acquaintance, so neither can observe co-experience, behaviora…

prs.p: PRS-23 recorded this paper's convergent-validity result *disjunctively* — "empirical demonstration of (or evidence about the limits of) convergent validity" — because what was in hand at PROP-2026-05-08-002 was the study's design and aim, not its findings. PRS-24 then built a field-deployment decision framework on top…
prs.r: The reported result of the same paper, now in hand (Zhou, West, Berman & Fredrickson, *Journal of Social and Personal Relationships* 42(10), 2025; doi:10.1177/02654075251359408): a confirmatory factor analysis on N = 274 undergraduates completing a 10-minute "fast friends" first-acquaintance conversation, entering all…
prs.s: Two things, and only the second is net-new. First, PRS-23's disjunction closes in the convergent direction — the three assessments load significantly on a single latent factor with good model fit, so positivity resonance is one construct measured three ways rather than three loosely related phenomena. Second, and abse…

prs.p: The tradition's flourishing claims rest almost entirely on correlational and cross-sectional evidence plus short-horizon lab inductions. Whether a positivity-resonance-derived intervention actually changes social behavior in the field, over a multi-year horizon, in a population selected for isolation rather than conve…
prs.r: A registered, invitation-enrolled RCT (NCT07005817) running 2025-05-19 to an estimated November 2027 primary completion, testing a tailored behavioral intervention for social connectedness in young adults, delivered with peer-created testimonial messages through simulated social media.
prs.s: Converts the intervention claim from an inference the existing data license into a pre-specified prospective test with a fixed endpoint — the design form the wiki flagged as missing when it recorded PRS-34 as "an inference the data license but do not test."

prs.p: The tradition's entire mechanism runs through what it calls real-time sensory connection — face-to-face co-presence supplying the shared affect, caring nonverbal synchrony, and biological synchrony that jointly constitute positivity resonance. Mediated channels lack most of that, so a social-media-delivered interventi…
prs.r: The trial's delivery mechanism — peer-created testimonial messages presented via *simulated* social media, used not to produce resonance directly but to change offline social behavior.
prs.s: Reframes the mediated channel as a motivational route to in-person connection rather than a substitute for it, which makes the design a test of whether the theory's causal chain can be entered from outside the face-to-face requirement. Either result is informative: success shows the resonance mechanism is reachable in…

prs.p: The wiki records the tradition's normative claims about flourishing communities as grounded in wellbeing science, but the funding and framing of the work have not been captured, and they bear on what the tradition is being asked to deliver.
prs.r: The National Cancer Institute's $3.25M award to Lazard and Fredrickson, situating loneliness reduction in young adults as a *cancer-prevention-adjacent public-health* problem, with Fredrickson holding UNC Lineberger Comprehensive Cancer Center membership.
prs.s: Locates the tradition's current empirical center of gravity in health-behavior change under public-health funding, rather than in the affective-science questions the wiki's PRS record is mostly built from — a shift worth noting because it predicts which questions get answered next.

prs.label: P2 (Text, pp.458–463) — Thomism and the cognitive turn
prs.p: Contemporary cognitive science is converging on universal cognition (basal cognition, active inference, teleodynamics, model-based agency) but lacks the metaphysical framework to interpret what this convergence means
prs.r: Thomistic resources: Aquinas's account of final causality and form, MacIntyre's tradition-constituted rationality, Stump's recovery of Thomism for analytic philosophy
prs.s: A C2A2-program paper (Loughran, DCEC) arguing that Thomism is a living, generative tradition that can organize inquiry across disciplines — drawing on Stump's recovery of Thomism to supply the missing metaphysical framework for the cognitive turn

prs.label: P4 (Implicit) — Final causality and modern biology
prs.p: Modern biology operates under a ban on teleological explanation (Mayr's 'teleonomy'), leaving morphogenetic goal-directedness (Levin) philosophically unaccounted for
prs.r: Thomistic hylomorphism: Aquinas's account of formal and final causality, recovered for contemporary philosophy through Stump's analytic Thomism
prs.s: A C2A2 integration claim (Loughran): Thomistic formal and final causality provides the philosophical framework within which Levin's morphogenetic teleology is not merely metaphorical but descriptive of real causal structure; teleonomy becomes teleology properly understood

prs.label: P5 (Implicit) — Suffering and divine permission
prs.p: The problem of evil — why a good God permits suffering — has generated competing theodicies that lack both empirical traction and philosophical rigor within analytic philosophy
prs.r: Stump's Aquinas and Wandering in Darkness: union as the final cause of permitted suffering; God permits suffering as a condition for the deep union that love seeks
prs.s: Suffering is instrumentally permitted for the highest intrinsic good (union with God and persons); not a theodicy of justification but of final causality — suffering is intelligible through its telos, not despite it

prs.label: P6 (Implicit) — Tradition vitality and the MacIntyre criterion
prs.p: How do we distinguish a living, progressive tradition from a degenerate one? And what makes Thomism worth taking seriously in contemporary interdisciplinary discourse?
prs.r: MacIntyre's criterion: a tradition is progressive if it can solve its own problems, identify genuine anomalies, and engage external challenges from a position of internal coherence
prs.s: C2A2 assessment (Loughran): Stump's body of work demonstrates Thomism meets the MacIntyre criterion — it has engaged analytic philosophy, cognitive science, and evolutionary biology without dissolving into them; a live, generative tradition

prs.label: P7 (PROP-2026-04-08-001) — Narrative cognition and philosophical epistemology
prs.p: Analytic theology has been dominated by propositional argumentation, but many theological traditions transmit their core insights primarily through narrative, and this form of knowledge is philosophically undertheorized
prs.r: Stump and Wolfe's edited volume on "Biblical Narratives and Human Flourishing": demonstrating that "narrative cognition" is a philosophical category — knowledge about human flourishing conveyed through and only fully accessible via engagement with specific narratives (not reducible to propositional summaries)
prs.s: A methodology for narrative biblical exegesis that is philosophically rigorous — enabling analytic theology to engage narrative traditions on their own terms without either reducing them to arguments or abandoning analytical standards

prs.label: P8 (PROP-2026-04-08-002) — Suffering reframed through narrative phenomenology
prs.p: Propositional theodicy cannot capture what biblical narratives know about suffering — the cognitive form of the knowledge matters, not just the content
prs.r: Stump's "Grains of Wheat" (OUP 2024/25): biblical narratives provide a possible-world argument for the compatibility of divine love and permitted suffering — not as abstract theodicy but as demonstrated through the experiential arc of persons the reader comes to know
prs.s: Biblical narratives enable second-personal narrative knowledge of suffering that is irreducible to propositional argument — stories teach what arguments cannot, because stories engage both intellect and imagination in the reader's becoming-acquainted with suffering agents

prs.label: P9 (PROP-2026-04-13-001) — Virtue as cooperative causality
prs.p: Contemporary virtue ethics typically treats virtues as stable character traits or habits, but Aquinas's account embeds the virtues within a metaphysics of the soul's powers and their transformation by grace — this richer framework is underexplored
prs.r: Stump's exposition of Aquinas on the seven cardinal virtues (Thomistic Institute podcast, January 2026): the Holy Spirit perfects the soul's natural powers, enabling the agent to will and act virtuously in a way that is genuinely the agent's own
prs.s: A philosophical psychology of virtue that is simultaneously naturalistic (virtues perfect natural powers) and theological (grace operates within the natural order) — providing a non-reductive account of moral transformation where agency and divine causality cooperatively constitute virtue

prs.label: P10 (PROP-2026-04-16-003) — Biblical Narratives and Human Flourishing: Knowledge Through Narrative
prs.p: The relationship between narrative and human flourishing lacks a rigorous philosophical framework — narrative theology remains disconnected from empirical flourishing research
prs.r: A multi-author research program building on Stump's Franciscan knowledge theory, connecting narrative epistemology to flourishing
prs.s: Biblical narratives provide knowledge-through-narrative that is constitutive of (not merely instrumental to) human flourishing — knowing persons through their stories is itself a form of flourishing

prs.label: P11 (PROP-2026-04-16-001) — Grains of Wheat: Suffering and Biblical Narratives
prs.p: Propositional philosophy of religion cannot capture the full meaning of suffering narratives — something is lost in abstraction
prs.r: Stump's theory of "Franciscan knowledge" (non-propositional, second-person) applied systematically to seven biblical narratives
prs.s: Narrative-mediated knowledge is philosophically rigorous and irreducible to propositions; it provides a form of understanding suffering that propositional theodicy cannot

prs.label: P12 (PROP-2026-04-16-001, 2nd candidate) — Grains of Wheat: Suffering and Biblical Narratives
prs.p: The problem of evil remains philosophically unresolved when treated only through analytic argument
prs.r: A unified reading of Hebrew Bible and New Testament suffering narratives as a single emergent story
prs.s: Suffering is "defeated" — not justified but redeemed — through a telos of personal union that requires vulnerability and loss as preconditions

prs.label: P13 (PROP-2026-04-16-002) — Suffering and Flourishing — Thomistic Institute Podcast with Fr. Gregory Pine, O
prs.p: The relationship between suffering and flourishing is typically framed as oppositional — flourishing is what happens when suffering stops
prs.r: Stump's Thomistic account of suffering as instrumentally ordered to a higher good (personal union / beatitudo), articulated in accessible podcast format
prs.s: Suffering and flourishing are not opposed but teleologically linked — suffering can be a condition for the deepest forms of human flourishing, understood as union with persons and with God

prs.label: P14 (PROP-2026-04-28-003 / src PROP-2026-04-27-001) — Hylomorphic metaphysics of corporate substance
prs.p: Contemporary metaphysics has no rigorous account of supra-individual wholes (peoples, communities, the church) that can include persons as constituents without either reducing the whole to an aggregate or dissolving the persons into a collective
prs.r: Thomistic hylomorphism extended via collective-neuroscience findings (mirror-neuron system, neural coupling, shared affective-cognitive substrate) to model "united somethings-or-others" as genuinely formed composite entities
prs.s: A hylomorphic metaphysics of the collective — peoples, communal guilt and shame, the church-as-body-of-Christ — in which the supra-individual whole has a real form that organizes its human constituents without dissolving their personhood

prs.label: P15 (PROP-2026-04-28-003, 2nd candidate) — Non-metaphorical body of Christ
prs.p: Theological claims about "the body of Christ" and "the people of God" are routinely treated as either metaphors or ecclesiological shorthand because no rigorous metaphysics of corporate persons is available in modern philosophy
prs.r: Stump's collective-neuroscience-informed hylomorphism, in which neural-level interpersonal coupling provides the empirical anchor for a metaphysics of corporate substance
prs.s: A non-metaphorical reading of "body of Christ" and analogous corporate-person claims — these become claims about real hylomorphic composites, empirically grounded but not reducible to neural mechanism

prs.label: P16 (PROP-2026-04-28-003, 3rd candidate) — Tradition as hylomorphic united-something-or-other
prs.p: MacIntyre's tradition-constituted rationality posits the tradition as a real bearer of inquiry, but lacks a metaphysical account of how a tradition is one thing — an entity whose constituents are persons but whose inquiry exceeds any individual's
prs.r: Hylomorphic collective-substance framework: the tradition as a united-something-or-other whose form organizes its human constituents' inquiry over time
prs.s: A Thomistic-MacIntyrean metaphysics of tradition: traditions are real composite entities, not aggregates of individual minds; their persistence across generations is form-persistence, not just memetic survival — directly serving the C2A2 architecture

prs.p: Even if suffering is defeated through union (the Wandering in Darkness solution), defeated suffering still merits mourning — and standard theodicies cannot explain how warranted mourning is compatible with a perfectly good God who permits what is mourned
prs.r: Stump's felix culpa account in The Image of God: the original sin is fortunate because there is an outweighing benefit to sufferers that could not be gotten in a world without suffering, joined to an account on which the mourned loss remains genuinely real, not explained away
prs.s: Mourning and theodicy are made compatible rather than rivals — the defeat of suffering does not erase its loss-character, so a perfectly good God can permit what warrants mourning; theodicy is completed by an ethics of mourning rather than by the elimination of grief

prs.p: Accounts of human flourishing oscillate between individualist (flourishing as internal state) and relational pictures without a principled account of what constitutes a person's true self
prs.r: The Image of God's treatment of the role of relationships in human flourishing and of what constitutes one's true self, developed within Stump's hylomorphic psychology
prs.s: Flourishing is constituted by relationship — the true self is the self in union with others and with God — giving the Thomistic wing a worked-out relational anthropology rather than a merely asserted one

prs.p: Analytic philosophy of religion has tended either to treat Aquinas as a historical curio or to extract isolated arguments from his system without committing to the metaphysical framework that makes those arguments work — leaving Thomism perpetually domesticated and therefore unable to challenge the host paradigm
prs.r: Stump and Zoll's "Good of Thomas Aquinas" essay, which argues that the metaphysical-ethical unity of Aquinas's system is itself the contribution — not particular doctrines but the integrated framework
prs.s: A defense of Thomism as a live, integrative research program whose value is exactly its non-extractability — the framework is the contribution, and partial appropriation always loses what was philosophically distinctive

prs.p: The C2A2 project's MacIntyre criterion (a tradition is alive iff it can solve its own problems and engage external challenges from within its own resources) needs first-person testimony from inside a tradition that the criterion is being met — and Thomism is the obvious test case
prs.r: A primary-source articulation by a leading analytic Thomist of why her tradition counts as alive — providing the inside-view warrant the C2A2 framework needs
prs.s: Use Stump-and-Zoll's argument as the canonical first-person Thomist self-statement of tradition vitality within the C2A2 wiki, paired with the MacIntyre external-criterion view

prs.p: Contemporary moral psychology lacks a structured taxonomy of failure modes for the will-intellect system; vice is treated either as character-trait deficit (virtue ethics) or as cognitive error (rationalist ethics), but neither captures the way vices recur as distinctive patterns in human moral life
prs.r: Stump's Thomistic exposition of the seven deadly sins as a structured typology of disordered will — each sin pivoting around a specific real good (pleasure, esteem, possession, etc.) misordered in object, manner, or measure relative to the agent's final end
prs.s: A philosophical psychology of moral failure in which the vices are not arbitrary prohibitions but predictable failure modes of an intellect-will system oriented toward goods that are themselves real — the negative-space complement to her virtue theory, completing a Thomistic dynamics of moral transformation

prs.p: Analytic philosophy lacks a rigorous account of how moral transformation can be both genuinely the agent's own act AND the work of an external causal agent (grace) — without collapsing into either Pelagian self-effort or determinist passivity
prs.r: Stump's reconstruction of Aquinas's "will-quiescence" — a state in which the will ceases to actively resist God's love without yet positively willing union; this is presented as a non-meritorious threshold condition that grace can then convert into the will of faith
prs.s: A two-stage model: (1) quiescence as the only "act" available to the unaided will, (2) infusion as the simultaneous arrival of grace, indwelling Spirit, and all infused virtues — preserving both agency and divine priority by locating them in different causal roles rather than in a competition for the same role

prs.p: Contemporary virtue ethics typically treats virtues as developmentally accumulated dispositions, but this leaves no room for the phenomenology of moral discontinuity (sudden conversion, instantaneous change of heart) that biblical and clinical literature both report
prs.r: The Thomistic distinction between acquired virtues (built up by practice) and infused virtues (received in an instant with grace), as systematized in Stump's article
prs.s: A dual-track virtue theory in which slow developmental virtue and instantaneous infused virtue are not rivals but operate at different levels of the soul's powers — providing a philosophical framework for moral discontinuity that is neither mystical nor reductive

prs.p: How does an agent move from moral deficiency to virtue — what is the mechanism of moral transformation? Purely voluntarist accounts (just try harder) and purely externalist accounts (grace alone) both fail to explain the phenomenology of genuine change
prs.r: Stump's Thomistic account of divine indwelling as a form of interior cooperation: the Holy Spirit perfects the soul's own powers, enabling the agent to will and act virtuously in a way that is genuinely the agent's own — Aquinas's synthesis of divine causality and human agency
prs.s: Moral transformation as cooperative causality — the agent's natural powers are genuinely operative but are elevated and directed by grace working within them. This offers a model of transformation that preserves agency while accounting for the inadequacy of unaided will

prs.p: Thomistic accounts of suffering and flourishing have largely been transmitted in lecture or written-essay form; the dialogical structure that Aquinas himself privileged (objection–response) has been underused as a contemporary mode of Thomistic theological transmission.
prs.r: A long-form Stump–Pine dialogue at the Thomistic Institute in which the audience hears the Thomistic argument unfold under a Thomist interlocutor's pressure — narrative arcs, suffering, flourishing, and personal union all developed conversationally rather than declaratively.
prs.s: A demonstration that Thomistic doctrine is dialogically robust — that its core claims can be tested in real-time peer dialogue and survive the test, providing a working model of MacIntyrean tradition vitality from within.

prs.p: The role of narrative arcs in making suffering intelligible — central to "Wandering in Darkness" and "Grains of Wheat" — has been articulated propositionally (PRS-08, PRS-11) but not yet demonstrated in the live, second-personal mode the theory itself privileges.
prs.r: The dialogue's explicit thematization of "the role of stories in understanding the arcs of our lives" — Stump narrating in real time how stories function as cognitive instruments rather than only theorizing about them.
prs.s: An instance of narrative cognition in action — Stump using narrative reasoning to discuss narrative reasoning, providing a meta-level case study for the Stump–Wolfe research program on knowledge-through-narrative (PRS-07, PRS-10).

prs.p: How does moral agency get off the ground in Aquinas if the infused virtues are given rather than acquired — does divine infusion bypass the agent's own willing?
prs.r: Aquinas's account of the will's quiescence: a non-resisting state that is genuinely the agent's own act, into which grace is infused so that the resulting virtuous willing is both God's gift and the agent's own.
prs.s: Reframes Aquinas's ethics as second-personal relationship rather than disposition-acquisition — cooperative causality preserves the agent's ownership of virtuous action while grounding it in the Holy Spirit's indwelling.

prs.p: How can God have certain, infallible knowledge of future contingents without collapsing their contingency into necessity?
prs.r: Cajetan's commentary on ST I q.14 a.13, reconstructed as an ordered set of relations between God's absolute, eternal nature and the relative, contingent nature of generated existents.
prs.s: A relational ordering in which eternal knowledge stands simultaneous-with rather than prior-to contingent events, preserving genuine contingency while grounding infallible divine knowledge — a later-scholastic sharpening of the Stump-Kretzmann ET-simultaneity account.

prs.p: The gnoseological question (how God knows) is characteristically treated apart from the metaphysical question (what time and eternity are), leaving divine foreknowledge an isolated epistemic puzzle.
prs.r: Cajetan's explicit linkage of the theory of divine knowledge to the metaphysics of temporality, eternity, necessity, and contingency.
prs.s: An integrated account in which the doctrine of divine knowledge is *derived from* a prior metaphysics of the eternity-time relation rather than bolted on — making the epistemology downstream of ontology.

prs.p: How does a philosopher working inside a premodern tradition give an account of her own work to a professional audience that does not share the tradition's commitments — without either translating the commitments away or refusing to translate at all?
prs.r: The John Dewey Lecture as a genre — retrospective, first-person, addressed to the whole discipline — occupied by an explicitly Augustinian-Thomistic thesis, Augustine's `dilige et quod vis fac` from the homilies on 1 John.
prs.s: A worked instance of MacIntyrean second-first-language competence: the tradition speaks in its own idiom (Latin maxim, patristic source) inside the rival's flagship venue and on the rival's terms of address. The lecture is thus itself a data point about tradition vitality, not merely a claim about it.

prs.s: Suffering love is a good that the metaphysically greater being cannot have. prs.p: Forgiveness is standardly credited with removing a wrongdoer's guilt and thereby restoring both his inner condition and his relationships to their pre-wrongdoing state. Can the act of forgiving actually do this?
prs.r: Stump's distinction (developed at length in *Atonement*) between guilt as an objective standing incurred by the wrongdoer and the relational rupture that wrongdoing produces — two things that come apart, and only one of which is in the victim's power to alter.
prs.s: On the abstract's report, Stump argues that forgiveness alone cannot remove guilt or effect restoration, so the standard account misdescribes what the forgiver is doing. The positive account of where the good lies is stated in the chapter, which was not retrieved.

prs.r: The same abstract's second target: the psychological-benefit rationale for forgiveness.
prs.s: Stump denies that forgiveness alone produces this peace. prs.s: Openness is never a virtue simpliciter. It is a virtue only under a discrimination condition administered by the recipient, which makes the moment of ratification constitutive of the relation rather than external to it.

Her cases are protein folding (function depends on th…

This is the C2…

prs.s: A worked example of inter-tradition adjudication that is weaker than MacIntyre's epistemological-crisis test but operational: a tradition gains comparative credit when a development neither tradition produced sits more naturally inside it. Stump concedes the result "certainly does not decide the issue" and that "it is…

prs.p: Open question 4 — does hylomorphic psychology map onto computational models of cognition (active inference, HTM)? A standing objection is that neural events precede reported mental acts (the Libet-style result), which seems to make the person's act an after-effect of sub-personal processing.
prs.r: Stump's face-recognition case ("Max" recognizing his daughter), run through blindsight, visual agnosia, and Capgras syndrome as dissociations that each remove a different part of the whole act, and her claim that on the anti-reductionist view "the causal power is not vested in any of the parts of the neural system alo…
prs.s: Neural precedence does not undermine top-down causation; it is what the view predicts: "Until the system is functioning as a whole, the causal power of the whole cannot be exercised." The person's act is the exercise of a level-specific causal power, and the sub-personal cascade is its material condition, not its riva…

prs.label: P1 (Text, pp.41–53) — Ontological closure vs. emergence
prs.p: Physicalism cannot easily account for consciousness, agency, or meaning without either eliminating them or invoking explanatory gaps
prs.r: Poetic naturalism: multiple levels of description (particles, organisms, persons) are all legitimate stories told about the same physical substrate
prs.s: A fully naturalist account of mind, meaning, and value that requires no ontological additions to physics, while preserving the validity of higher-level descriptions

prs.label: P2 (Text, pp.44–47) — Quantum interpretation
prs.p: The measurement problem in quantum mechanics creates apparent discontinuities that tempt non-physical interpretations (consciousness causes collapse, etc.)
prs.r: Many-Worlds Interpretation: the wavefunction never collapses; all outcomes occur in branching Everettian worlds
prs.s: A philosophically principled resolution of the measurement problem that invokes no consciousness, no hidden variables, and no new physics — just the unmodified Schrödinger equation

prs.label: P3 (Text, pp.47–53) — Rival theory evaluation
prs.p: Novel physical theories (Wolfram Physics, Quantum Holonomy Theory, Conscious Realism) claim to unify physics but lack empirical traction
prs.r: Bayesian theory confirmation: novel theories must demonstrate tangible explanatory gains over established physics before warranting acceptance
prs.s: A methodological standard that keeps physics honest: welcome novel frameworks but require them to recover known physics and generate new predictions

prs.label: P4 (Implicit) — Agency without dualism
prs.p: Accounts of human agency often require either dualism (a non-physical will acting on the body) or eliminativism (agency is an illusion)
prs.r: Carroll's compatibilism: agency is a useful high-level description of physical processes; free will is compatible with determinism if properly understood
prs.s: A deflationary but non-eliminativist account of agency: persons really do act, but acting is a pattern in the physical substrate, not a violation of it — preserving moral responsibility without dualism

prs.label: P5 (Implicit) — Science–religion dialogue
prs.p: Science and religion appear to conflict because both make claims about the same domain (reality); naive harmony is intellectually dishonest
prs.r: Poetic naturalism's distinction between core ontology (physics) and useful stories (meaning, value, purpose) — religion traffics in the latter
prs.s: A framework where science and religion can coexist without either capitulating: science owns the core ontology, religion provides coherent stories about meaning at the human level

prs.label: P6 (Implicit, via document contrast) — Physicalism's explanatory limit
prs.p: Carroll's framework has no resources for explaining why there is something rather than nothing, or why mathematical structures are empirically instantiated
prs.r: Carroll's own use of the 'why is there something?' question as an edge of physics — acknowledging limits
prs.s: An acknowledged boundary condition that opens space for Thomistic engagement: Carroll's naturalism, rigorously applied, reaches its own limit precisely where Thomistic metaphysics begins

prs.label: P7 (PROP-2026-04-07-004) — Observer-centric quantum gravity
prs.p: Quantum mechanics and general relativity remain unreconciled after decades of effort, with no convergence on a theory of quantum gravity
prs.r: A new observer-centric framework (Harlow et al.) — treating the observer as a classical, mathematically well-defined entity within the theory, with new rules for observer-system interactions
prs.s: Rather than deriving the observer from quantum mechanics, build the observer into the foundations — a "precise Copenhagen" that may resolve the measurement problem while naturally incorporating gravitational effects

prs.label: P8 (PROP-2026-04-08-004) — Intelligence as multidimensional across species
prs.p: Carroll's poetic naturalism needs a positive account of what "mind" tracks across different biological systems — not just that mind-language is a valid higher-level description, but what feature of complex systems it describes
prs.r: Erica Cartmill (Santa Fe Institute) on comparative cognitive science: intelligence is multidimensional, non-linear across species — some numerical competencies present in chimpanzees, social intelligence (play, teasing, humor) as a distinct cognitive axis separate from problem-solving
prs.s: Carroll's emergence thesis gains empirical specificity: minds are not points on a single axis from simple to complex, but multi-dimensional systems where different capacities emerge independently — supporting the view that consciousness/agency are emergent real patterns, not just useful fictions

prs.label: P9 (PROP-2026-04-08-005) — Biological agency as naturalist research program
prs.p: Standard physicalist accounts of organisms treat them as passive products of selection pressure acting on random variation — but this appears to eliminate genuine biological agency
prs.r: Jessica Riskin's historical re-reading of Lamarck's creative agency (PROP-2026-04-08-005): organisms possess an internal agentive force that is not reducible to external selection or random mutation — they are active participants in life, not passive recipients
prs.s: A naturalistic framework for biological agency that goes beyond compatibilism without invoking dualism — organisms as genuine agents within Carroll's physicalism, grounded in historical precedent that predates modern physics

prs.label: P10 (PROP-2026-04-09-003) — Observer problem in Many-Worlds interpretation
prs.p: Many-Worlds interpretations of quantum mechanics struggle to define "observer" without circularity or infinite regress — Witten's critique holds that knowing one's measurement outcome requires a meta-observer, who requires another meta-observer, with no principled stopping point
prs.r: Carroll's response in April 2026 AMA: the observer is defined functionally within the wavefunction via decoherence — there is no external observer required; "knowing an outcome" is itself a physical correlation between memory state and environmental state
prs.s: A fully physicalist account of observation, knowledge, and memory within Many-Worlds that dissolves Witten's regress by treating all observer-states as internal physical correlations in the wavefunction — at the cost of requiring that "experience" is fully described by physical correlations, which the Consciousness Cl…

prs.label: P11 (PROP-2026-04-13-010) — Emergence classification and ontological taxonomy
prs.p: The concept of "emergence" is used loosely across philosophy and science — some mean epistemic convenience, others mean genuine ontological novelty, and the ambiguity undermines productive cross-tradition dialogue about consciousness, agency, and causation
prs.r: Carroll & Parola's dynamics-based classification of emergence (2024): Type-0 (featureless), Type-1 (local), Type-2 (with new ontological elements); grounded in state spaces and evolution rules rather than subjective judgments
prs.s: A precise, physics-inspired taxonomy that lets rival traditions specify exactly what kind of emergence they are claiming — forcing clarity on whether consciousness is Type-1 emergent (reducible in principle) or Type-2 (requiring genuinely new ontological ingredients), providing shared vocabulary for C2A2 network's cen…

prs.label: P12 (PROP-2026-04-16-002) — Mindscape 350: J. Eric Oliver on The Self and How to Know It
prs.p: The nature of the self is contested across philosophy, psychology, neuroscience, and social science — with no consensus on whether the self is a real entity, a useful fiction, or an emergent construct
prs.r: Empirical social science perspective on self-knowledge — treating the self as a constructed narrative that can be studied through behavioral and cognitive data rather than resolved through metaphysics
prs.s: A naturalist research program on the self that sidesteps metaphysical commitments (does the self "really" exist?) in favor of studying how self-knowledge functions, fails, and can be improved — consistent with Carroll's poetic naturalism

prs.label: P13 (PROP-2026-04-17-001) — Mindscape AMA | April 2026 — Wheeler-DeWitt, Timeless Universe, and Boltzmann Br
prs.p: If time is not fundamental and the universe is a static Wheeler-DeWitt wavefunction with "moments" appearing as components, how does the apparent directional flow and lawful ordering of physical time arise without being put in by hand?
prs.r: Carroll's 2026 AMA reformulation — a basis selection in the universal wavefunction such that branches hosting observers, records, and lawful physics have concentrated amplitude, while branches hosting Boltzmann-brain-like fluctuations are mathematically suppressed
prs.s: A timeless quantum cosmology in which the arrow of time, the reality of observers, and the rarity of Boltzmann brains all emerge from the structure of the wavefunction plus a principled basis choice — preserving poetic naturalism (higher-level descriptions real but emergent) at the cosmological scale
